Yes! Flaviar offers several subscription options that deliver premium spirits regularly:
Whiskey Subscription:
Quarterly deliveries that include 1 full-size 750ml bottle of whiskey and 1 curated 3-vial Tasting Box with whiskey samples. You can choose between pay-as-you-go (pay before each delivery) or prepay for a year (4 deliveries in advance at a discount).
Champions of Bourbon Subscription:
Monthly deliveries of bourbon bottles. Available as pay-as-you-go (monthly payments) or prepaid plans for 3, 6, 9, or 12 months with a discount.
Founder's Picks Subscription:
Monthly deliveries of premium whiskeys (worth at least $180 each) hand-picked by Flaviar's co-founder. Shipments are sent automatically each month.
All subscriptions renew automatically by default, though you can change this setting anytime in your Subscription Dashboard.
